resources.name: LCAO tight-binding parameters and Si(001)2×1 surface geometry

access.notes: Parameters for Si substrate and alkali-metal adsorbates are available from published references cited within the paper. The agent must locate and extract the onsite energies, hopping integrals, and atomic coordinates.
Installable via pip. Recommending Tsinghua mirror: python3 -m pip install -q --no-cache-dir -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple numpy scipy
